# DramaPanda

> > Asian drama news, reviews, and episode recaps covering Chinese dramas, K-dramas, and celebrity entertainment

DramaPanda is a dedicated entertainment blog focusing on Asian television dramas, particularly Chinese and Korean series. The site features episode recaps, first impressions reviews, production news, celebrity updates, and streaming statistics for popular shows like Meteor Garden 2018, Our Glamorous Time, and Listening Snow Tower.

## Key Topics

- Meteor Garden 2018
- Chinese drama
- Korean drama (K-drama)
- Episode recaps
- F4
- Our Glamorous Time
- First impressions & reviews
- Tencent streaming
- Dao Mingsi & Shan Cai
- Celebrity news
- Modern drama
- Wuxia & historical drama
- Tang Wei
- Zhao Liying
- Production news

## Drama Series & Reviews

- [Our Glamorous Time (2018)](https://dramapanda.com/2018/10/our-glamorous-time-2018.html): Office romance drama: Zhao Li Ying & Jin Han in Ding Mo business adaptation
- [The Mask](https://dramapanda.com/2018/09/the-mask.html): Crime thriller with Raymond Lam: serial killer with multiple personalities
- [Listening Snow Tower (2019)](https://dramapanda.com/2019/02/listening-snow-tower.html): Wuxia drama: Qin Junjie & Yuan Bingyan in Cang Yue martial arts adaptation
- [IET's Shake It 2 (2018)](https://dramapanda.com/2018/09/iets-shake-it-2-2018.html): Sci-fi romance web series: time-travel & alien historical fantasy sequel
- [First Impressions: The Guest](https://dramapanda.com/2018/09/first-impressions-guest.html): Review: OCN's The Guest supernatural horror with possession & exorcism themes
- [First Impressions: Devilish Joy](https://dramapanda.com/2018/10/first-impressions-devilish-joy.html): Review: Devilish Joy K-drama with Choi Jin-Hyuk in amnesia romance plot
